title: smilax oldhamii var. ussuriensis
intro: Smilax oldhamii var. ussuriensis, commonly known as Smilax root or Ussuri Smilax, is a type of climbing plant that belongs to the Smilacaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Smilax root include soothing and calming effects, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Smilax root include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
